MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The SanDisk card feels like a natural next choice because I repeatedly buy SD and microSD cards, and the familiar 32GB capacity and included adapter fit that pattern.",
    "The HDMI cable and Fire TV Stick connect with my TV-related purchases. I'd consider streaming and appreciate flexible cable placement; the remote's TV controls appeal more than 4K on my current TV."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The drive mounting kit, network switch, extender, and modem solve specific problems I haven't shown a need to solve. Buying device accessories doesn't mean I'm upgrading desktop storage or fixing my network.",
    "The earbuds and speaker don't connect closely to my current interest in camera supplies and practical device accessories. I don't have a listening-related need during this visit.",
    "Both Fire TV Sticks interest me for the same purpose, but I'd choose the one with TV controls rather than buy both."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as interest in almost any electronic device, even when its purpose is unrelated to what I've been buying.",
    "My purchases of cables and adapters seem to have been stretched into an interest in networking and internal computer hardware, although those require different needs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of memory cards, tripods, a card reader, storage cases, and a lens cap suggest ongoing camera and storage accessory needs that deserve more attention.",
    "The exact connection, device fit, and practical use matter to me: a compatible card or useful cable is more compelling than equipment that needs an unmentioned upgrade project.",
    "Interest in a product doesn't necessarily mean I need every similar version; the two streaming sticks would be alternatives for me."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my memory-card and TV interests, but stretched my practical accessory purchases into unrelated electronics needs."
}
